ruleDefinitions.name: Webshell ReGeorg Detection Via Web Logs
ruleDefinitions.description: Certain strings in the uri_query field when combined with null referer and null user agent can indicate activity associated with the webshell ReGeorg. Note: Unmapped fields: cs-uri-query, cs-referer, cs-user-agent, cs-method

sequences.query: (cs-uri-query = RGX(".*cmd\\=read.*") OR cs-uri-query = RGX(".*connect\\&target.*") OR cs-uri-query = RGX(".*cmd\\=connect.*") OR cs-uri-query = RGX(".*cmd\\=disconnect.*") OR cs-uri-query = RGX(".*cmd\\=forward.*")) AND (cs-referer = "None" AND cs-user-agent = "None" AND cs-method = "POST")
